data.exact_reserve_text:
Prior year reserve development
The movement in the net provision for claims includes adverse prior year development of GBP 0.7m (2016: GBP 1.1m adverse). Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a small prior-year release on gross claims outstanding of GBP 1.221m (a c.0.86% reduction versus opening gross reserves of GBP 141.815m). The movement is reflected in the technical provisions reconciliation and appears driven by favourable claims development overall and an increase in reinsurer recoveries. Line level movements (presented in the notes net of reinsurance) show mixed experience across lines, with notable releases in Property and Casualty offset by adverse movement in certain other lines and the reinsurance portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes adverse prior year development of GBP 0.7m (2016: GBP 1.1m adverse).
The Directors consider that the provisions for gross claims and related reinsurance recoveries are fairly stated on the basis of the information currently available to them.
The loss for the financial year is attributable to catastrophe and risk losses incurred during the year

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities technical provisions) - prior year comparative column. Prior year development (gross) taken from technical provisions reconciliation (Change in prior year provisions = -GBP 1,221k). The narrative in note 4 refers to net prior-year adverse development of GBP 0.7m; per extraction rules gross movements were used. Line-by-line prior year movements in the 'Prior year reserve development' table are presented net of reinsurance; gross by line is not provided, so LOB movement entries use net values and have lower confidence. Claims development triangle (gross) is available and included; units in that table are GBP '000.
